Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `pins.txt` is the sha256 list CI checks. `tools/check_vendor_pins.py` fails when a `vendor/*.whl` digest, its `.sha256` sidecar, or a `voxprint-common==` pin in `pyproject.toml` or a `requirements*.txt` file disagrees with that list. The `pin` job calls the voxprint-common v0.6.4 template `.github/workflows/pin-check.yml` with `tag: v0.6.4` and `lock: vendor/pins.txt`, so that list has to match the release wheel. The model-index job checks `mdl.json` against the signed index and the bundled `model-index.pin.json`. It does not run the pin check again.

- `voxprint_common-0.6.4-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.6.4 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.6.4/voxprint_common-0.6.4-py3-none-any.whl (tag `v0.6.4`, merge commit e47f3dccf84f04102b11c5eab87fdaa16de1655b; sha256 `1b7abcc99530d6f155b4be41fba26f3f27b8b54789d49282b936430c53a4314b`). The release has no combined SHA256SUMS file. Each archive has a `.sha256` sidecar, and that sidecar matches this digest and the GitHub asset digest. It bundles the same serial 9 signed model index as 0.4.1 (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f), the voxprint-model/1 schema (sha256 e46ae56a…5138), the voxprint-app-models/1 schema (sha256 ed451b99…c420), and the index public key (`mdl/data/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.6.4`. `SUITE_APPS` includes `model-forge`. `voxprint-mdl-gui` is the windowed entry point. `paths.read_home()` does not fall back to the legacy home (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Voxprint`, `~/.local/share/voxprint`); the Windows setup moves it first (`installer/windows/migrate-home.ps1`), and Model Forge only uses `paths.home()`-based helpers, which migrate on first use. This wheel includes `voxprint-mdl cleanup` and `voxprint_common.worker`. Model Forge uses the worker for the Photos image check. It does not call `voxprint-mdl cleanup`.
